Anomaly hint one-consonant-diverge ACCEPTED as a defect, but re-classified: the link target 'Jastrow, בּוּר I 1' (B00328) is CORRECT — הוֹבִיר is the Hif. of בּוּר I — and it is the anchor's display text that is corrupt. The display reads בּיּר (yod carrying the dagesh) where the word is בּוּר (shuruk, וּ): a vav-with-dagesh misread as yod-with-dagesh. בּוּר occurs 892× in the corpus, בּיּר 3×, and all three are anchor displays whose targets are correctly וּ/ִי-spelled headwords. Repair needs a ו byte not present in this entry, so no patch.
